title: Alien Cake Addict panics in spooky way when cake is spawned on player

labels.name: C-Examples
labels.description: An addition or correction to our examples

body:
## Bevy version

b6be8a5314e027a0b0f3ee48d04c14b52fe74676

## Operating system & version

macOS

## What you did

I played a lot of alien cake addict, but here's a shortcut:

```rs
    game.bonus.i = game.player.i; //rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..BOARD_SIZE_I);
    game.bonus.j = game.player.j; //rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..BOARD_SIZE_J);
```
